facts.fact: The Minister of ICT and National Guidance's policy statement for FY 2025/26, of March 2025, lists among the year's priorities connecting essential service centres, local governments among them with schools, hospitals, tourism sites and police, to the national backbone, in line with NDP IV; the programme as a whole is allocated Ushs 323 billion, of which Ushs 193.81 billion is external development financing and Ushs 13.79 billion domestic, with no amount given for local governments.
facts.system: Connection of local governments to the National Backbone Infrastructure

facts.fact: The connection of local governments to the national backbone is a stated FY 2025/26 priority of the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, with the backbone run by its agency NITA-U, as of March 2025.
